title: A Simple Doxastic Deontic Logic for Norm-Guided Decision Making
abstract: arXiv:2610.00668v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Making decisions despite conflicting norms and incomplete or unreliable information is a fundamental challenge for autonomous systems. We introduce a simple doxastic deontic logic for this setting: a classically reducible fragment of Chellas' Minimal Deontic Logic, extended with explicit conditional norms and combined with multi-agent KD45, so that norms can depend on agents' beliefs about both facts and norms. On this logic we define the Doxastic Norm Compliance Optimization Problem, where an agent chooses a decision minimizing weighted norm violations. We distinguish subjective optimization (relative to the agent's beliefs) from objective optimization (relative to the actual facts). We give conditions under which (i) the two coincide and (ii) optimal decision-making can be reduced to weighted partial MaxSAT in polynomial time.

translated_title: 一种用于规范引导决策的简单信念道义逻辑
translated_abstract: 在规范相互冲突且信息不完整或不可靠的情况下做出决策，是自主系统面临的一项根本性挑战。我们为此引入了一种简单的信念道义逻辑：它是Chellas最小道义逻辑的一个经典可归约片段，扩展了显式条件规范，并与多主体KD45相结合，使得规范可以依赖于主体对事实和规范的信念。在该逻辑的基础上，我们定义了信念规范遵从优化问题，即主体选择一个使加权规范违反最小化的决策。我们区分了主观优化（相对于主体的信念）与客观优化（相对于实际事实），并给出了以下条件：（i）二者何时相一致，以及（ii）最优决策何时可以在多项式时间内归约为加权部分MaxSAT问题。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合多主体KD45的简单信念道义逻辑以支持冲突规范下的自主决策，定义了信念规范遵从优化问题，并证明了在特定条件下最优决策可在多项式时间内归约为加权部分MaxSAT问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a simple doxastic deontic logic combining multi-agent KD45 for norm-guided decision making under conflicting norms and incomplete information, defines the Doxastic Norm Compliance Optimization Problem, and shows that optimal decision-making can be reduced to weighted partial MaxSAT in polynomial time.
